# MemeDrop

> The humor layer for AI agents. An AI-assisted API that turns text context into captioned meme images.

MemeDrop selects a relevant meme template, generates captions, and renders an image for an agent or application. The API is in private beta. Access and credits must be arranged with the operator; paid checkout is not open. Landing-page examples are curated illustrations, not live API responses. The video shows an earlier Chrome extension workflow; Chrome Web Store release is pending.

## Integration

- [API documentation](https://memedrop.moyezrabbani.dev/docs/): Request/response schemas, authentication, idempotency, errors, and image retrieval.
- API origin: https://api.memedrop.moyezrabbani.dev
- Generation: POST /api/v1/memes/generate. Requires Authorization: Bearer <API key>, Idempotency-Key, and JSON input. Optional options.direction and options.count are documented in the API guide.
- Successful responses contain meme IDs, image_url, and expires_at. Image downloads require the owning user's Bearer credential and expire after 30 days.
- One credit is charged per successfully stored and returned meme. Unused reservations are refunded on failure or partial output. A matching idempotent replay is not charged again. A no_fit result is free.
- Keep credentials server-side. Never put API keys in URLs or browser code.
